user_request: Revise the release mandate for Shared Review using my correction. Explain the outcome, boundaries, feasibility, and evidence still needed.

trusted_context.correction: This quarter concerns adoption among 240 eligible existing workspaces, not acquisition or monetization. Keep current entitlements. Treat the older brief as superseded on those points.

source_records.text: Reach 900 workspaces and 2,700 users through a paid campaign; make Shared Review a premium add-on.
Of the 240 eligible workspaces, 96 enabled the feature and 36 completed a second shared review within 14 days. Manual handoff effort is not measured.
Only 24 additional support hours are allocated this quarter. Assisted onboarding takes 1.5 hours per workspace. The sponsor wants less coordination effort without disrupting existing workflows.
